data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 516.08m. During 2019 there was adverse prior year development on gross claims of GBP 51.449m (a strengthening). The reported drivers include prior year development in Financial Lines following a detailed reserving review and update to reserving assumptions, current accident year large losses within Technical Risks (notably Downstream Energy) and catastrophic loss issues within the Global Re division. The movement is disclosed in the Technical Provisions reconciliation.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year development in our Financial Lines division, following a detailed reserving review and an update to certain reserving assumptions during the year;
current accident year issues within our Technical Risks division due to a number of large losses within the Downstream Energy class; and
catastrophic loss issues within our Global Re division.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the gross prior year movement were taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (page 41). The prior year development is the gross column value 'Change in prior year provisions' (51,449 in GBP 000). No explicit sentence describing the prior year movement was present aside from the table row, so that table row text was used verbatim. The report names divisional drivers (Financial Lines, Technical Risks, Global Re) but does not quantify the prior year movement by line of business, so LOB-level amounts are unavailable (lob_movements amounts left null). No specifically named catastrophe events affecting prior years are listed in the document. A claims development table appears in the notes but the explicit movement figure was available in the movement table so the triangle was not used as primary source.
